domain: Query-processing system with a performance SLA.

glossary.definition: A single request submitted to the system for processing.
Authentication credential issued per registered caller, used to identify the source of each query and enforce per-client rate limits.

business_rules.rule: Each registered API client is subject to a rate limit of 100 queries per second; requests exceeding this limit must receive an HTTP 429 response and must not be queued for processing.
